GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.93 (15 Oct 45) GC-P
(SCAPIN - 141)
APO 500
15 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Direction of Japanese Civil Weather Service.
The Commanding General, Far Eastern Air Forces, has been charged with:
a. Initiating action to organize or rehabilitate the existing Japanese Weather service.
b. The coordination of the disposition of all Japanese weather stations, meteorological instruments, records, equipment and material.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
